description: Stack three 5 cm cubes into a single tower on the red block's footprint, using a Franka Panda. Planning runs against the pyroffi MCP server; execution runs in a stepped MuJoCo simulation with a real tendon-driven gripper closing on real blocks. The arm is mounted at the world origin and the ground plane is z=0.

conventions.joint_order: name-keyed; use the actuated joint names from get_capabilities

robot_setup.grasp_note: A top-down grasp puts the panda_hand frame origin grasp_standoff_m above the block centre, with the hand's local +z along world -z (wxyz [0, 0, 1, 0], yaw free). Plan with the fingers ignored: the planning model has 7 actuated joints and the gripper is commanded separately with set_gripper.

easy.note: Free tabletop. Tests the pipeline, not the geometry.

wall.note: A 25 cm divider stands between block_blue and the rest of the workspace. A straight-line joint-space transfer drives through it, so optimize_between alone is not enough: the seed has to lift over the wall. It is placed 0.15 m out so the hand can still reach block_green without fouling it -- the spherized hand is a coarse collision blob and clears less than its visual mesh suggests.

scoring.note: report() reads the simulator, so it cannot be satisfied by a plan that was never executed.

execution.simulation_model: MuJoCo Menagerie franka_emika_panda (real finger meshes, tendon gripper)
execution.kinematic_agreement: panda_hand and the Menagerie 'hand' body agree to 1e-7 m; a joint-space plan transfers with no translation
execution.note: Motions start from the configuration observe() reports -- execution does not teleport. Pass times_s from retime(): an unretimed reference pulls a held block out of the gripper.
